_comment: Single source of truth for Luz's ruler swing geometry, read by both scripts/player/ruler_weapon.gd (procedural weapon sprite) and tools/generate_luz_slash_smears.py (crescent smear art). All positions are in world/hitbox units (feet-origin, right-facing, y negative = up), matching player.gd's Attack Hitboxes export group and Godot's own y-down 2D convention. design_scale converts world units to the native-art design pixels the Python smear generator draws in (design_pixels = world_units * design_scale).
angle_convention: degrees, standard atan2(y,x) in Godot's y-down 2D space: 0=front/+x, 90=down, 180=behind/-x, 270=up. tip = pivot + rotate(tilt_deg, (rx*cos(theta), ry*sin(theta))).

ground_1.description: Diagonal cut, up-and-behind windup to low-front contact (chop over the top).

ground_2.description: Horizontal forward cut, short punchy raise-and-snap (flat ellipse, no tilt) -- deliberately shorter angular span and untilted vs ground_1/ground_3 so it reads as a distinct forward strike, never sweeping toward the back.

ground_3.description: Finisher: widest, thickest, longest sweep, over the top to a low-front follow-through.

crouch.description: Low flat sweep near the ground, forward.

up.description: Straight upward thrust with a slight forward lean, reaching as far above the head as the lateral attacks reach beyond the body front edge.
